en_quote: The table below summarizes different categories of technology solutions:
knowledge_zh: 表格概述不同类别的技术解决方案

en_quote: Publicly available watchlists offer basic compliance checks.
knowledge_zh: 公开可用的观察名单提供基本合规检查

en_quote: Paid solutions integrate screening into case management workflows with real-time risk scoring and ongoing monitoring.
knowledge_zh: 付费解决方案将筛查集成到案件管理工作流中，提供实时风险评分和持续监控

en_quote: AI-driven monitoring tools, particularly those in enterprise solutions, detect behavioral anomalies in financial transactions, flagging high-risk activities for further review.
knowledge_zh: AI驱动的监控工具检测行为异常并标记高风险活动

en_quote: While free tools can support investigative efforts, paid solutions provide scalability, automation, and enhanced accuracy in risk identification.
knowledge_zh: 付费解决方案相比免费工具提供可扩展性、自动化和更高的准确性

en_quote: Deciding the level of automation in an investigation requires balancing machine-driven efficiency with human oversight. For example, automated transaction monitoring systems flag unusual activity, but human analysts must review and validate alerts to avoid false positives.
knowledge_zh: 调查中需平衡自动化效率与人工监督

en_quote: Automation streamlines investigations by prioritizing high-risk cases, but overreliance on machine-generated outputs can overlook contextual factors that only human judgment can assess.
knowledge_zh: 自动化可优先处理高风险案件，但过度依赖可能忽略人工判断的上下文因素

en_quote: Conversely, fully manual investigations are inefficient and resource intensive.
knowledge_zh: 完全人工调查效率低下且资源密集

en_quote: A balanced approach, using technology to automate repetitive tasks while maintaining expert oversight for final decisions, ensures accuracy, compliance, and effective risk mitigation.
knowledge_zh: 平衡方法：用技术自动化重复任务，同时保留专家监督最终决策

en_quote: By combining free and subscription-based investigative tools, financial crime teams can optimize their workflows and enhance regulatory compliance efforts.
knowledge_zh: 结合免费和订阅调查工具优化金融犯罪团队工作流程与合规
